newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products steady to stronger.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products steady to stronger.

text.p: Med oil products were all steady to stronger on Thursday, traders said.
Gas oil prices remained firm with tight prompt supplies, particularly of diesel but also 0.2 sulphur material and healthy forward demand supportive.
Traders said tender for early August deliveries in to Turkey and Syria for up to seven cargoes were keeping sentiment firm while limited local demand was balancing the tight prompt market.
0.2 sulphur material was traded at a steady benchmark quotes high +$4 a tonne on Wednesday.
A London-based products trader confirmed he had sold a Greek naphtha cargo in the Med to an end-user in the area at $190 CIF Med for August 5-10 loading.

The deal, which was expected to lift quotes by around $4-$5 on the day, was in the context of a tightening Med market that was expected by brokers to see large-scale arb movements to the East and the US Gulf during the remainder of July and through August.
High sulphur fuel oil cargoes were stronger, with bunker spec cracked material on offer from southern France at high fob Med plus $4 with buying interest seen into Genoa.
Other market players were also heard looking for material to take into Naples, Gibralatar and Las Palmas.
"There is also some refinery demand and not too many supplies, so the market is stronger," one trader said.

Russian material continues to be absent from the market but traders said one cargo of Turkish straight-run out of Mercin was being offered at a strong price, given its lower quality, high cif Augusta +$2.

Low sulphur was also stronger with few avails seen. One of two Russian pieces on offer was traded at high cif +$5.50, with the buyer said to have paid the high premium as it needed the cargo very promptly.
Traders said Greece issued a tender for the purchase of low sulphur straight-run fuel. The tender closes on July 24-25, they added.

Gasoline was $1-2 a tonne stronger taking a lead from firmer NYMEX gasoline and stronger physical levels in NWE. Several traders commented that wet activity in the Mediterranean was quiet with at least one player fully covered for August.
